races.title: State Senate, District 12
races.note: The top two finishers from the Nov 3, 2026 count. Everyone else in this race is coming.

cands.name: Jim Burgin
cands.bio: Republican state senator for District 12 (Harnett, Lee and part of Sampson counties) since January 2019. Owner and president of C&D Insurance, president of B.C. Property, Inc., a real estate development company, and a partner in car dealerships. Former two-term Harnett County commissioner and board chairman.
cands.gaps: We could not find where he was raised or when he moved to North Carolina, so his ties to the state could not be scored. We found no sourced actions or statements from him on data centers, homestead property taxes, foreign or investor land buying, growth and land conservation, immigration or H-1B, policing, guns, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. His campaign site lists him as president of a real estate development company, but we found no records of how that business connects to any development decision. We found no news reports of controversies and no endorsements listed for 2026. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2020, 2022, 2024 or 2026. We found no documented foreign ties.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: State senator since 2019 (four terms) with several committee chair posts. Two terms as Harnett County commissioner, including time as board chairman. Owns and runs an insurance agency, a real estate development company and a car-dealership partnership.
qual.why: He has prior legislative service and local elected office, plus long experience owning and managing businesses. The committee chair posts were not counted toward the score.
qual.label: He has prior legislative service and local elected office, plus long experience owning and managing businesses. The committee chair posts were not counted toward the score.

cands.name: Tanya White Anderson
cands.bio: Democratic candidate for North Carolina State Senate District 12 in 2024 and 2026. U.S. Army veteran and advocate for veterans, public education and working families. Ballotpedia lists ties to NAPFE local 316 and NAACP Local 5473. She has not held elected office.

endorsements.text: Ballotpedia lists 2026 endorsements from Center for Freethought Equality, Planned Parenthood Votes! South Atlantic, Young Democrats of North Carolina, and the voter guides Reject AIPAC from City Council to Congress and Unburdening The Ballot.
Ballotpedia lists 2024 endorsements from the Labor Caucus of the North Carolina Democratic Party, Center for Freethought Equality, Lillian House and Planned Parenthood Votes.

cands.gaps: We could not find where Tanya White Anderson was born or raised, or when she came to North Carolina. We found no employment history beyond her U.S. Army service and her affiliations with a postal and federal employees union local and an NAACP local. We found no stated positions on data centers, property taxes, development or land protection, foreign land ownership, immigration, policing, gun laws, abortion or school choice. The only education statement is about funding for public schools and teacher pay. Her Ballotpedia survey answers are brief and give no detail on policy.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: U.S. Army service and veterans advocacy; Ballotpedia lists affiliation with a postal and federal employees union local and an NAACP local. No occupation, legislative or budget work history is given.
qual.why: The pages do not describe a career, business or office held, so job fit cannot be scored.
qual.label: Background not found: unknown, not unqualified

school-choice-teachers.evidence: Her campaign site says she will fight for increased funding for public schools and higher teacher pay. It does not address vouchers or charters, and the raise is not a 25% figure.
